dict.string: LifeLog compares scheduled events with what actually happened.
LifeLog uses the camera for photos, documents, whiteboards, and receipts you choose to preserve.
LifeLog uses contacts you approve to resolve people consistently across your own memories.
LifeLog reads only the health categories you choose so sleep, workouts, steps, and heart signals can inform your timeline.
Allow LifeLog to record significant location changes and visits automatically in the background.
LifeLog uses location to reconstruct visits, travel, and the context of your day.
LifeLog connects directly to your self-hosted server on your local network when you configure one.
LifeLog records audio only when you explicitly begin a recording and can continue while the screen is locked.
LifeLog uses motion activity and step history to distinguish walking, cycling, driving, and stationary periods.
LifeLog can associate new photos with the surrounding timeline when you enable photo-library observation.
LifeLog can observe new photo and video metadata automatically, or import only items you select, according to your chosen access level.
LifeLog synchronizes reminders with commitments and completion evidence.
